categories.main_business_segments: Obio Technology (Shanghai) Corp., Ltd. focuses on cell and gene therapy technology services, providing CRO services such as gene therapy vector development and gene function research, and CDMO services including IND-CMC pharmaceutical research and clinical sample GMP production. The company also produces and sells biological reagents and kits. Its services cover the entire drug development cycle from discovery, preclinical research, clinical trials to commercial production.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company has developed core technology clusters in gene therapy vector development and production process and quality control. It utilizes advanced molecular biology platforms, virus vector packaging platforms, cell function research, SPF animal experiment platforms, clinical-grade vector and cell therapy process development, and quality control technology platforms. Key production methods include large-scale cell culture, plasmid transfection, virus purification, and GMP-compliant manufacturing with proprietary platforms like AAVNeO®, LVVNeO™, BigAdenO®, CytoNeO, and PacNeO. It also develops non-viral vectors such as mRNA-LNP and exosomes.
categories.primary_customers_markets: The company's primary customers are research institutions, hospitals, and pharmaceutical companies engaged in cell and gene therapy drug development. It serves clients globally, including in China and the United States, supporting over 10,000 research laboratories and assisting in obtaining 32 IND approvals in China and the US. The markets served include oncology, rare diseases, neurological, hematological, cardiovascular, and other difficult-to-treat diseases.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates mainly in China with headquarters and major facilities in Shanghai, including a 77,000 square meter precision medical industrial base in the Shanghai Free Trade Zone Lingang New Area. It has subsidiaries and operations in the United States and Beijing, and is actively expanding its presence in global biopharmaceutical markets, especially in the US and Asia-Pacific regions.
categories.supply_chain_position: Obio operates primarily as a midstream contract research and manufacturing organization (CRO/CDMO) in the cell and gene therapy supply chain. It provides outsourced R&D, process development, clinical and commercial manufacturing services, bridging early-stage research and commercial production for biopharmaceutical companies.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes innovation in gene therapy vector development, large-scale GMP production process optimization, and quality control technologies. It invests heavily in R&D, focusing on novel viral and non-viral vectors, high-yield cell lines, AI-assisted vector screening, and process scale-up. It also emphasizes domestic key material and equipment localization to reduce supply chain risks and cost. Strategic expansion includes global market penetration, talent acquisition, and enhancing integrated one-stop CRO/CDMO services.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated primarily through direct sales of customized CRO and CDMO services for gene therapy drug development, including vector development, process development, clinical and commercial GMP manufacturing, and sales of biological reagents and kits. The company uses milestone-based and progress-based billing for CDMO services and point-in-time recognition for CRO and reagent sales.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Obio is positioned among the leading domestic companies in the cell and gene therapy CRO/CDMO sector, with a comprehensive technology platform and large-scale GMP production capacity. It competes with over 35 domestic CDMO companies and faces competition from large multinational CRO/CDMO firms entering the gene therapy field. Its competitive advantages include broad service coverage, advanced proprietary technologies, extensive project experience, and a growing global footprint.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2023, the company reported operating revenue of approximately RMB 204.8 million, a 29.7% decrease from the previous year, and a net loss attributable to shareholders of RMB 127.9 million. The decline was mainly due to reduced CDMO business revenue amid industry financing challenges and increased operating costs from new facility ramp-up and R&D investments. The company’s total assets reached RMB 2.6 billion, with a workforce of 731 employees. Despite short-term losses, the company is investing heavily in capacity expansion and R&D to capture future growth.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Obio emphasizes its comprehensive one-stop CRO/CDMO service platform covering the entire cell and gene therapy drug development cycle, supported by proprietary core technologies and large-scale GMP production capabilities. Its differentiation lies in advanced vector development platforms, high-yield cell lines, flexible production scales up to 2000L bioreactors, and strong IP protection. The company’s integrated service model reduces client coordination complexity, accelerates drug development timelines, and lowers production costs, aiming to be a leading international gene and cell therapy CXO group.
